rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the bike is pedal-powered, especially a bicycle.

example.english: I bike to work every morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 caai2 daan1 ce1 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when the bike is motor-powered, such as a motorcycle or scooter.

example.english: I ride my bike to buy groceries after work.
example.traditional: 我放工後揸電單車去買餸。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 hau6 zaa1 din6 daan1 ce1 heoi3 maai5 sung3
